messages:
IncidentBot: 🔔 ALERT: increased 5xx rate on /v1/chat (us-east-1) — 12% over 10m (threshold 1.5%). Pager: paging SRE Rotation.
Maya: Im taking this. Looking at logs now.
Theo: Heads up: Im seeing an influx of batched upstream requests from a scheduled worker that just rolled out at 02:00 UTC. Could be a traffic surge.
Ravi: Customer-impact: a handful of enterprise customers in APAC reported slower responses and some timeouts. CS flagged 3 non-critical tickets.
Maya: Quick plan: 1) enable routing to lighter quantized model for non-enterprise keys, 2) apply a short silence for the noisy aggregate alert to stop paging, 3) open maintenance window for a config roll. Executing 1 now.
Maya: Routing switch command: `rtroute promote --from=model-v3 --to=model-lite-q --filter="tier!=enterprise" --pct=30`
OpsBot: Routing change accepted. 30% traffic rerouted to model-lite-q (op id: op-9924).
Theo: Ill patch the scheduled worker to add jitter and reduce parallelism. Wont be instant but should cut downstream fanout.
Maya: Adding silence: `alertctl silence create --alert=chat_5xx_rate --scope=us-east-1 --duration=20m --reason="mitigation window"`
IncidentBot: Silence created (id: sil-88ff). Maintenance window created (mw-8822) duration 20m. Action logged.
Ravi: Can folks confirm whether the enterprise traffic is still routed to primary model? we should keep them on stable path.
Maya: Confirmed enterprise keys untouched. We routed non-enterprise traffic only.
Theo: Infra quick-fix: bump model-pool in us-east-1 by +1 GPU, running `infractl pool adjust --pool=model-us-east --add=1`
OpsBot: Scaling action queued; new instance will be ready in ~3m.
Maya: Observability notes: dashboard `prod/chat/errors` shows 5xx falling from 12% to 4% after reroute and infra bump. Latency stable.
Ravi: Good. For alerts: current chat_5xx_rate fires at 1.5%/10m; that's very aggressive for scheduled-worker windows. Proposing temporary threshold to 5% for 24h and add a separate alert for enterprise-only spikes at 1%.
Theo: Agreed. We don't want noise from background jobs to muffle real enterprise regressions.
Maya: Draft config to push: ```yaml
- alert: chat_5xx_rate
  scope: us-east-1
  threshold: 5
  window: 10m
  note: temporary relax for batch-window mitigation
- alert: chat_5xx_rate_enterprise
  scope: us-east-1
  threshold: 1
  window: 5m
  filter: tier==enterprise
  note: enterprise-sensitive rule
```
Maya: Pushing to canary then prod if green. Will tag changes in monitoring repo.
IncidentBot: Canary deployment passed. Promoting config to prod.
Ravi: While we relax the global threshold, please ensure we keep the silence short and remove it manually once infra changes land.
Maya: Removing silence after config deploy: `alertctl silence remove sil-88ff`
IncidentBot: Silence removed (sil-88ff). New thresholds in effect.
SRE Rotation: Handoff note  Maya is primary for mitigation and monitoring for next 30m. Theo will finalize the scheduled-worker fix and rollout. Ravi will coordinate any customer comms.
Maya: Running 12m of synthetic checks and per-customer error rate scans. Will post results.
Theo: I pushed worker patch to canary with reduced parallelism and randomized start. Command used: `kubectl patch cronjob worker --patch '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid","startingDeadlineSeconds":120}}'`
Theo: Canary success. Rolling to prod in 10m.
Maya: Synthetic traffic steady. Overall 5xx at 0.6% after mitigation and pool scale. Enterprise metrics stable at 0.2%.
Ravi: CS update: sent a proactive note to impacted customers summarizing mitigation steps and that were monitoring. No immediate customer escalations.
Maya: Post-incident tuning plan: - leave relaxed threshold for 24h - schedule an eval after 48h of normal traffic - add a dashboard panel for scheduled-worker correlation - add CI test to simulate batch fanout
SRE Rotation: Adding follow-ups in the incident tracker: ticket #INC-2034 (routing decisions), #INC-2035 (alert rules), #INC-2036 (worker jitter + CI test), owner tags: Maya/Theo/Ravi.
Maya: Creating the short postmortem doc and timeline; will include commands used, decision rationale, and a customer impact list.
Ravi: Before we close: verify silence removed (done), maintenance mw-8822 ended (opsbot will auto-end).
OpsBot: Maintenance mw-8822 ended at 1814004940.
Maya: Last check: 20m green. Ill handoff to Theo for the next 30m of watch and then we can finalize postmortem PR.
Theo: On watch. Ill also open the PR to adjust alert docs and add the enterprise-only rule.
IncidentBot: Incident closed: mitigation successful, monitoring changes active, follow-ups logged.
